Baudh3.3.22-1cd/ tair eva sadṛśī vṛttiḥ pratyakṣaṃ svarga.lakṣaṇam //
body.translated_text:
Baudh3.3.22: Moving about with the deer, dwelling together with them,
having a livelihood similar to theirs — [this is] a visible sign of heaven.

body.text:
Baudh3.3.22-2/ pratyakṣaṃ svarga.lakṣaṇam iti // [Baudh3.3.22 = Baudh3.2.19]
Baudh3.4.1/ atha yadi brahmacāry avratyam iva (caret^māṃsaṃ vā^(aśnīyātstriyaṃ vā^(upeyāt sarvāsv eva^ārtiṣu //
body.translated_text:
Baudh3.3.22 (cont.): A visible sign of heaven. Thus. [Baudh3.3.22 = Baudh3.2.19]
Baudh3.4.1: Now, if a <s>brahmacārin</s> (celibate student) should conduct himself as if he had broken his vow — if he eats meat or approaches a woman — in all such transgressions:

body.text:
Baudh3.4.2/ antar.āgāre^agnim (upasamādhāya (saṃparistīrya^ā^agnimukhāt(kṛtvā[cf. Baudh2.8.14.7]^atha^ājya.āhutīr (upajuhoti / kāmena kṛtaṃkāmaḥ (karoti kāmāya^eva^idaṃ sarvaṃ yo mā (kārayati tasmai svāhā /manasā kṛtaṃ manaḥ (karoti manasa eva^idaṃ sarvaṃ yo mā (kārayati tasmaisvāhā / rajasā kṛtaṃ rajaḥ (karoti rajasa eva^idaṃ sarvaṃ yo mā(kārayati tasmai
svāhā / tamasā kṛtaṃ tamaḥ (karoti tamasa eva^idaṃsarvaṃ yo mā (kārayati tasmai svāhā / pāpmanā kṛtaṃ pāpmā (karotipāpmana eva^idaṃ sarvaṃ yo mā (kārayati tasmai svāhā / manyunā kṛtaṃmanyuḥ (karoti manyava eva^idaṃ sarvaṃ yo mā (kārayati tasmai svāhā^iti//
body.translated_text: Baudh3.4.2: Having placed the fire inside the house, having spread [the sacrificial grass] around, having performed the preliminary rites up to the <s>agnimukhā</s> [cf. Baudh2.8.14.7], he then offers <s>ājya</s> (ghee) oblations: 'What was done by desire — desire does it, all this is for desire alone; to him who causes me [to act], <s>svāhā</s>! What was done by mind — mind does it, all this is for mind alone; to him who causes me [to act], <s>svāhā</s>! What was done by <s>rajas</s> (passion) — <s>rajas</s> does it, all this is for <s>rajas</s> alone; to him who causes me [to act], <s>svāhā</s>! What was done by <s>tamas</s> (darkness) — <s>tamas</s> does it, all this is for <s>tamas</s> alone; to him who causes me [to act], <s>svāhā</s>! What was done by sin — sin does it, all this is for sin alone; to him who causes me [to act], <s>svāhā</s>! What was done by anger — anger does it, all this is for anger alone; to him who causes me [to act], <s>svāhā</s>!' Thus.

body.text: Baudh3.4.3/ jaya.prabhṛti siddham ā dhenu.vara.pradānāt //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.4.3: The [procedure] beginning with the <s>Jaya</s> [oblations] is established [as standard], up to the gift of a cow.

body.text: Baudh3.4.4/ apareṇa^agniṃ kṛṣṇa.ajinena prācīna.grīveṇa^uttara.lomnāprāvṛtya vasati //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.4.4: Behind the fire, having covered himself with a black antelope skin with its neck facing east and hair side up, he lies down [for the night].

body.text: Baudh3.4.5/ vyuṣṭāyāṃ [K: atha vyuṣṭāyāṃ] jaghana.ardhād ātmānam(apakṛṣya tīrthaṃ (gatvā prasiddhaṃ(snātvā^antar.jala.gato^aghamarṣaṇena ṣoḍaśa prāṇa.āyāmān(dhārayitvā prasiddham ā^āditya.upasthānāt (kṛtvā^ācāryasya gṛhān(eti //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.4.5: When dawn has appeared [K: then when dawn has appeared], having separated himself from the lower half [of the skin], having gone to a <s>tīrtha</s> (sacred ford), having bathed according to the established [rite], standing within the water, having held sixteen <s>prāṇāyāmas</s> (breath-restraints) with the <s>Aghamarṣaṇa</s> [hymn], having performed the established [rite] up to the worship of the sun, he goes to the teacher's house.

body.text: Baudh3.4.6/ yathā^aśvamedha.avabhṛtha evam [k: yathāśvamedhāvabhṛtham]eva^etad (vijānīyād iti //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.4.6: One should understand this to be just like the concluding bath of the <s>Aśvamedha</s> (horse sacrifice) [K: just like the concluding bath of the <s>Aśvamedha</s>]. Thus.

body.text: Baudh3.5.1/ atha^ataḥ pavitra.atipavitrasya^aghamarṣaṇasya kalpaṃ(vyākhyāsyāmaḥ //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.5.1: Now, we shall explain the ritual procedure of the <s>Aghamarṣaṇa</s> [hymn], which is purifying and supremely purifying.

body.text: Baudh3.5.2/ tīrthaṃ (gatvā snātaḥ śuci.vāsā udaka.ante sthaṇḍilam(uddhṛtya sakṛt.klinnena vāsasā sakṛt.pūrṇenapāṇinā^āditya.abhimukho^aghamarṣaṇaṃ svādhyāyam (adhīyīta //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.5.2: Having gone to a <s>tīrtha</s> (sacred ford), having bathed, wearing clean garments, at the water's edge, having cleared a spot on the ground, with a garment moistened once, with a handful filled once, facing the sun, one should recite the <s>Aghamarṣaṇa</s> as one's <s>svādhyāya</s> (self-study recitation).

body.text: Baudh3.5.3/ prātaḥ śataṃ madhya.ahne śatam apara.ahṇe śatam aparimitaṃ vā //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.5.3: A hundred [times] in the morning, a hundred at midday, a hundred in the afternoon, or an unlimited [number].

body.text: Baudh3.5.4/ uditeṣu nakṣatreṣu prasṛti.yāvakaṃ [K: prasṛtayāvakaṃ](prāśnīyāt //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.5.4: When the stars have risen, one should eat a handful of barley gruel [K: barley gruel by the handful].

body.text: Baudh3.5.5/ jñāna.kṛtebhyo^ajñāna.kṛtebhyaś ca^upapātakebhyaḥ sapta.rātrāt(pramucyate dvādaśa.rātrād bhrūṇa.hananaṃ guru.talpa.gamanaṃsuvarṇa.stainyaṃ surā.pānam iti ca (varjayitvā //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.5.5: From minor sins (<s>upapātakas</s>) committed knowingly or unknowingly, one is freed after seven nights — excluding the killing of an embryo, approaching a teacher's wife, stealing gold, and drinking <s>surā</s> (liquor) — [one is freed] after twelve nights.

body.text: Baudh3.5.6/ ekaviṃśati.rātrāt tāny api (tarati tāny api (jayati //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.5.6: After twenty-one nights, one overcomes and conquers even those [great sins].

body.text: Baudh3.5.7/ sarvaṃ (tarati sarvaṃ (jayati sarva.kratu.phalam (avāpnoti sarveṣutīrtheṣu snāto (bhavati sarveṣu vedeṣu cīrṇa.vrato (bhavati sarvairdevair jñāto (bhavaty ā cakṣuṣaḥ paṅktiṃ (punāti karmāṇi ca^asya(sidhyanti^iti baudhāyanaḥ //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.5.7: One overcomes all, one conquers all, one obtains the fruit of all sacrificial rites, one becomes as one who has bathed at all sacred fords, one becomes as one who has fulfilled the vows of all the <s>Vedas</s>, one becomes known to all the gods, one purifies [one's] lineage up to the range of sight, and one's ritual actions succeed — thus [says] <s>Baudhāyana</s>.

body.text: Baudh3.6.1/ atha karmabhir ātma.kṛtair gurum iva^ātmānaṃ(manyeta^ātma.arthe prasṛti.yāvakaṃ [K: prasṛtayāvakaṃ] (śrapayeduditeṣu nakṣatreṣu //
body.translated_text: Now, one who considers himself weighty as a teacher on account of self-performed deeds should cook for himself a <s>prasṛti</s> (handful) of barley gruel when the stars have risen.

body.text: Baudh3.6.2/ na tato^agnau (juhuyāt //
body.translated_text: He should not offer from it into the fire.

body.text: Baudh3.6.3/ na ca^atra bali.karma //
body.translated_text: And there is no <s>bali</s> (offering) ritual here.

body.text: Baudh3.6.4/ aśṛtaṃ śrapyamāṇaṃ śṛtaṃ ca^(abhimantrayeta //
body.translated_text: He should consecrate it with <s>mantras</s> when uncooked, while being cooked, and when cooked.

body.text:
Baudh3.6.5-1ab/ yavo^asi dhānya.rājo^asi vāruṇo madhu.saṃyutaḥ /
Baudh3.6.5-1cd/ nirṇodaḥ sarva.pāpānāṃ pavitram ṛṣibhiḥ smṛtam //
body.translated_text: 'You are barley, king of grains, associated with <s>Varuṇa</s>, combined with honey; you are the expeller of all sins, declared by the <s>ṛṣis</s> (sages) to be a purifier.'

body.text:
Baudh3.6.5-2ab/ ghṛtaṃ yavā madhu yavā āpo vā [K: yavā] amṛtaṃ yavāḥ /
Baudh3.6.5-2cd/ sarvaṃ (punīta [K: punatha] me pāpaṃ yan mayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam //
body.translated_text: 'Ghee, O barley; honey, O barley; waters, O barley; nectar, O barley — purify all my sin, whatever evil deed has been done by me.'

body.text:
Baudh3.6.5-3ab/ vācā kṛtaṃ karma kṛtaṃ manasā durvicintitam /
Baudh3.6.5-3cd/ alakṣmīṃ kāla.karṇīṃ [K: kālarātrīṃ] ca sarvaṃ (punīta[K: punatha] me yavāḥ //
body.translated_text: 'Sin committed by speech, sin committed by action, evil thought by the mind — <s>Alakṣmī</s> (misfortune), <s>Kālakarṇī</s> (the dark-eared one) — purify all [this] for me, O barley.'

body.text:
Baudh3.6.5-4ab/ śva.sūkara.avadhūtaṃ ca [K: yat] kāka.ucchiṣṭa.hataṃ [K:kākocchiṣṭopahataṃ] ca yat /
Baudh3.6.5-4cd/ mātā.pitror aśuśrūṣāṃ sarvaṃ (punīta [K: punatha] me yavāḥ //
body.translated_text: 'That which has been defiled by a dog or pig, and that which has been contaminated by the leavings of a crow, disobedience to mother and father — purify all [this] for me, O barley.'

body.text:
Baudh3.6.5-5ab/ mahā.pātaka.saṃyuktaṃ dāruṇaṃ rāja.kilbiṣam /
Baudh3.6.5-5cd/ bāla.vṛddham [K: bālavṛttam] adharmaṃ ca sarvaṃ (punīta [K:punatha] me yavāḥ //
body.translated_text: 'That which is joined with great sins, terrible royal offenses, and <s>adharma</s> (unrighteousness) against the young and the old — purify all [this] for me, O barley.'

body.text:
Baudh3.6.5-6ab/ suvarṇa.stainyam avratyam ayājyasya ca yājanam /
Baudh3.6.5-6cd/ brāhmaṇānāṃ parīvādaṃ sarvaṃ (punīta [K: punatha] me yavāḥ //
body.translated_text: 'Stealing of gold, breach of vows, sacrificing for one who should not be sacrificed for, and slander of brahmins — purify all [this] for me, O barley.'

body.text:
Baudh3.6.5-7ab/ gaṇa.annaṃ gaṇikā.annaṃ ca śūdra.annaṃ śrāddha.sūtakam /
Baudh3.6.5-7cd/ corasya^annaṃ nava.śrāddhaṃ sarvaṃ (punīta [K: punatha] meyavāḥ // iti //
body.translated_text: 'Food of a group, food of a prostitute, food of a <s>śūdra</s>, funerary food at a birth-impurity period, food of a thief, and a recent funeral offering — purify all [this] for me, O barley.' Thus [end the verses].

body.text: Baudh3.6.6/ śrapyamāṇe rakṣāṃ (kuryāt / namo rudrāya bhūta.adhipataye /dyauḥ śāntā / (kṛṇuṣva pājaḥ prasitiṃ na pṛthvīm ity etena^anuvākena[K omits: ity etenānuvākena] / ye devāḥ puraḥsado^agni.netrāḥ +rakṣo.haṇa iti pañcabhiḥ paryāyaiḥ / mā nas toke / brahmā devānām itidvābhyām //
body.translated_text: While [the barley] is being cooked, he should perform a protective [rite]: '<s>Namo Rudrāya bhūtādhipataye</s>' ('Salutation to <s>Rudra</s>, lord of beings'); '<s>Dyauḥ śāntā</s>' ('Heaven is peaceful'); with the <s>anuvāka</s> (section) '<s>Kṛṇuṣva pājaḥ</s>' ('Make firm your might like the broad earth'); with the five stanzas '<s>Ye devāḥ puraḥsado agni-netrāḥ rakṣohaṇaḥ</s>' ('Those gods who sit in front, led by <s>Agni</s>, slayers of demons'); and with the two [verses] '<s>Mā nas toke</s>' ('Not in our offspring') and '<s>Brahmā devānām</s>' ('<s>Brahmā</s> of the gods').

body.text: Baudh3.6.7/ śṛtaṃ ca laghv (aśnīyāt prayataḥ pātre (niṣicya //
body.translated_text: And when cooked, he should eat it lightly, in a state of purity, having poured it into a vessel.

body.text: Baudh3.6.8/ ye devā mano.jātā mano.yujaḥ sudakṣā dakṣa.pitāras te naḥ(pāntu te no^(avantu tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā^iti / ātmani (juhuyāt//
body.translated_text: '<s>Ye devā manojātā manoyujaḥ sudakṣā dakṣapitāraḥ, te naḥ pāntu te no'vantu, tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā</s>' ('Those gods born of mind, yoked by mind, skillful, fathers of skill — may they protect us, may they help us; salutation to them, <s>svāhā</s> to them') — with this [<s>mantra</s>] he should offer into himself.

body.text: Baudh3.6.9/ tri.rātraṃ medha.arthī //
body.translated_text: For three nights, [this rite is performed] by one desiring mental vigor.

body.text: Baudh3.6.10/ ṣaḍ.rātraṃ (pītvā pāpa.kṛt^śuddho (bhavati //
body.translated_text: Having drunk [the barley gruel] for six nights, a sinner becomes purified.

body.text: Baudh3.6.11/ sapta.rātraṃ (pītvā bhrūṇa.hananaṃ guru.talpa.gamanaṃsuvarṇa.stainyaṃ surā.pānam iti ca (punāti //
body.translated_text: Having drunk [it] for seven nights, it purifies [even the sins of] embryo-killing, approaching the teacher's wife, stealing gold, and drinking <s>surā</s> (liquor).

body.text: Baudh3.6.12/ ekādaśa.rātraṃ (pītvā pūrva.puruṣa.kṛtam api pāpaṃ (nirṇudati //
body.translated_text: Having drunk [it] for eleven nights, one drives away even sin committed by one's ancestors.

body.text: Baudh3.6.13/ api vā go.niṣkrāntānāṃ yavānām ekaviṃśati.rātraṃ (pītvāgaṇān (paśyati gaṇa.adhipatiṃ (paśyati vidyāṃ (paśyati vidyā.adhipatiṃ(paśyati^ity āha bhagavān baudhāyanaḥ //
body.translated_text: Or, having drunk for twenty-one nights [the gruel] of barley that has passed through a cow, one sees the <s>gaṇas</s> (hosts [of divine beings]), sees the lord of the <s>gaṇas</s>, sees the [sacred] knowledge, sees the lord of knowledge — so says the revered <s>Baudhāyana</s>.

body.text: Baudh3.7.1/ kūśmāṇḍair [K: atha kūṣmāṇḍair] (juhuyād yo^apūta iva (manyeta //
body.translated_text: One who considers himself impure should offer oblations with the <s>Kūṣmāṇḍa</s> [<s>mantras</s>].

body.text: Baudh3.7.2/ yathā steno yathā bhrūṇa.hā^evam eṣa (bhavati yo^ayonau retaḥ(siñcati //
body.translated_text: 'Just as a thief, just as an embryo-slayer — so is he who deposits semen in an improper place.'

body.text: Baudh3.7.3/ yad arvācīnam eno bhrūṇa.hatyāyās tasmān (mucyata iti //
body.translated_text: 'From whatever sin falls short of embryo-killing, from that one is freed' — thus [it is declared].

body.text: Baudh3.7.4/ ayonau retaḥ (siktvā^anyatra svapnād arepā vā pavitra.kāmaḥ[K: pavitrakāmo vā] //
body.translated_text: Having deposited semen in an improper place, except in a dream, or [being] free from reproach, one desiring purification [should perform the following].

body.text: Baudh3.7.5/ amāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā keśa.śmaśru.loma.nakhāni(vāpayitvā brahmacāri.kalpena vratam (upaiti //
body.translated_text: On the new-moon day or the full-moon day, having had his hair, beard, body-hair, and nails shaved, he undertakes the vow in the manner of a <s>brahmacārin</s> (student).

body.text: Baudh3.7.6/ saṃvatsaraṃ māsaṃ caturviṃśaty.ahaṃ [K: caturviṃśatyaho] dvādaśarātrīḥ ṣaṭ tisro vā //
body.translated_text: [The duration is] a year, a month, twenty-four days, twelve nights, six, or three.

body.text: Baudh3.7.7/ na māṃsam (aśnīyān na striyam (upeyān na^(uparyāsīta(jugupseta^anṛtāt //
body.translated_text: He should not eat meat, should not approach a woman, should not sleep on an elevated [bed], and should abhor falsehood.

body.text: Baudh3.7.8/ payo.bhakṣa iti prathamaḥ kalpaḥ / yāvakaṃ vā^upayuñjānaḥkṛcchra.dvādaśa.rātraṃ (cared (bhikṣed vā //
body.translated_text: A milk diet is the first option; or subsisting on barley gruel, he should observe a <s>kṛcchra</s> (austerity) of twelve nights, or beg for alms.

body.text: Baudh3.7.9/ tad.vidheṣu yavāgūṃ rājanyo vaiśya āmikṣām //
body.translated_text: For those of his kind [performing this rite], a <s>kṣatriya</s> [should take] barley gruel and a <s>vaiśya</s> sour milk.

body.text: Baudh3.7.10/ pūrvāhṇe pākayajñika.dharmeṇa^agnim (upasamādhāya(saṃparistīrya^ā^agnimukhāt (kṛtvā^atha^ājya.āhutīr (upajuhoti [Komits: athājyāhutīr upajuhoti] / yad devā deva.heḍanam [K: devahelanam]/ yad adīvyann ṛṇam ahaṃ (babhūva / āyuṣ ṭe viśvato (dadhad iti / etaistribhir [K: etais tridity] anuvākaiḥ //
body.translated_text: In the forenoon, having set up the fire in the manner of a <s>pākayajña</s> (domestic sacrifice), having strewn [the grass] around it, and having performed [the rites] up to the <s>agni-mukha</s> (fire-facing), he then offers <s>ājya</s> (ghee) oblations [with the hymns]: '<s>Yad devā deva-heḍanam</s>' ('Whatever offense against the gods, O gods'); '<s>Yad adīvyann ṛṇam ahaṃ babhūva</s>' ('Whatever debt I have incurred without gambling'); '<s>Āyuṣ ṭe viśvato dadhad</s>' ('Placing your life on all sides') — with these three <s>anuvākas</s> (sections).

body.text: Baudh3.7.11/ praty.ṛcam ājyasya (juhuyāt [K: hutvā] //
body.translated_text: He should offer ghee verse by verse.

body.text: Baudh3.7.12/ siṃhe vyāghra uta yā pṛdākāv iti catasraḥ sruva.āhutīḥ /agne^abhyāvartin / agne aṅgiraḥ / punar ūrjā / saha rayyā^iticatasro^abhyāvartinīr (hutvā samit.pāṇir yajamāna.loke^(avasthāya /vaiśvānarāya prati (vedayāma iti dvādaśarcena sūktena^(upatiṣṭhate [K:sūktenopasthāya] //
body.translated_text: With the four [verses] '<s>Siṃhe vyāghre uta yā pṛdākau</s>' ('In lion, tiger, and serpent'), [he offers] four ladle-oblations; [then with] '<s>Agne abhyāvartin</s>' ('O <s>Agni</s>, who turns toward'), '<s>Agne aṅgiraḥ</s>' ('O <s>Agni</s> of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>'), '<s>Punar ūrjā</s>' ('Again with nourishment'), '<s>Saha rayyā</s>' ('Together with wealth') — having offered [these] four <s>abhyāvartinī</s> (returning) oblations, standing in the sacrificer's place with fuel-stick in hand, he recites the twelve-versed hymn '<s>Vaiśvānarāya prati vedayāma</s>' ('We announce to <s>Vaiśvānara</s>').

body.text: Baudh3.7.13/ yan mayā [K: me] manasā vācā kṛtam enaḥ kadācana / sarvasmāttasmān [K: sarvasmān] mā^īḍito [K: meWito] (mogdhi tvaṃ hi (vetthayathā.tathaṃ svāhā^iti / samidham (ādhāya varaṃ (dadāti //
body.translated_text: 'Whatever sin has ever been committed by me in mind or speech — from all that, O praised one, release me; for you know [things] as they truly are, <s>svāhā</s>' — with this [<s>mantra</s>], he places a fuel-stick [on the fire] and gives a gift.

body.text: Baudh3.7.14/ jaya.prabhṛti siddham ā dhenu.vara.pradānāt //
body.translated_text: From the <s>jaya</s> [oblations] onward, the procedure is established, up to the giving of the cow as a gift.

body.text: Baudh3.7.15/ eka eva^agnau paricārī [K: paricaryāyām] //
body.translated_text: Only one [person] tends the fire.

body.text: Baudh3.7.16/ atha^agnyādheye [K: agnyādheye] / yad devā deva.heḍanam [K:devodevamahelanam] / yad adīvyann ṛṇam ahaṃ (babhūva / āyuṣ ṭe viśvato(dadhad iti / pūrṇa.āhutīḥ [K: pūrṇāhutim] //
body.translated_text: Now, at the establishment of the sacred fires (<s>agnyādheya</s>): [with the hymns] '<s>Yad devā deva-heḍanam</s>' ('Whatever offense against the gods, O gods'), '<s>Yad adīvyann ṛṇam ahaṃ babhūva</s>' ('Whatever debt I have incurred'), '<s>Āyuṣ ṭe viśvato dadhad</s>' ('Placing your life on all sides') — [he offers] full oblations.

body.text: Baudh3.7.17/ (hutvā^agnihotram ārapsyamāno daśahotrā / (hutvādarśapūrṇamāsāv ārapsyamānaś caturhotrā / (hutvā cāturmāsyānyārapsyamānaḥ pañcahotrā / (hutvā paśubandhe ṣaḍḍhotrā / (hutvā [Komits hutvā] some saptahotrā //
body.translated_text: Having offered [the purificatory rites], one about to commence the <s>agnihotra</s> [performs] the <s>daśahotrā</s> (ten-priest formula); one about to commence the new-moon and full-moon sacrifices, the <s>caturhotrā</s> (four-priest formula); one about to commence the seasonal sacrifices, the <s>pañcahotrā</s> (five-priest formula); one about to commence the animal sacrifice, the <s>ṣaḍḍhotrā</s> (six-priest formula); one about to commence the <s>Soma</s> sacrifice, the <s>saptahotrā</s> (seven-priest formula).

body.text: Baudh3.7.18/ (vijñāyate ca [K: omits ca] / karma.ādiṣv etair (juhuyāt /pūto deva.lokān (samaśnuta iti hi brāhmaṇam / iti hi brāhmaṇam //
body.translated_text: And it is known [from scripture]: 'One should offer with these [formulas] at the beginning of [each] rite; [thereby] purified, one attains the worlds of the gods' — so states the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>; so states the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.

body.text: Baudh3.8.1/ atha^ataś cāndrāyaṇasya kalpaṃ [K: cāndrāyaṇakalpaṃ](vyākhyāsyāmaḥ //
body.translated_text: Now we shall explain the procedure of the <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s> (lunar penance).

body.text: Baudh3.8.2/ śukla.caturdaśīm (upavaset //
body.translated_text: One should fast on the fourteenth [day] of the bright [fortnight].

body.text: Baudh3.8.3/ keśa.śmaśru.loma.nakhāni (vāpayitvā^api vā śmaśrūṇy eva^ahataṃvāso vasānaḥ satyaṃ bruvann āvasatham (abhyupeyāt //
body.translated_text: Having had his hair, beard, body-hair, and nails shaved — or only the beard — wearing an unworn garment, speaking the truth, he should approach the ritual dwelling.

body.text: Baudh3.8.4/ tasminn asya sakṛt.praṇīto^agnir araṇyor nirmanthyo vā //
body.translated_text: In that [dwelling], his fire is to be kindled once, or produced by friction from the fire-sticks.

body.text: Baudh3.8.5/ brahmacārī suhṛt praiṣāya^upakalpī (syāt //
body.translated_text: A <s>brahmacārin</s> (student) friend should serve as the one who issues commands and makes preparations.

body.text: Baudh3.8.6/ haviṣyaṃ ca vrata.upāyanīyam [K: vratopāyanam] //
body.translated_text: And the oblation-worthy [food] is the offering for undertaking the vow.

body.text: Baudh3.8.7/ agnim (upasamādhāya (saṃparistīrya^ā^agnimukhāt (kṛtvāpakvāj (juhoti //
body.translated_text: Having set up the fire, having strewn [the grass] around it, and having performed [the rites] up to the <s>agni-mukha</s> (fire-facing), he offers from the cooked [food].

body.text: Baudh3.8.8/ agnaye yā tithiḥ syān nakṣatrāya sa.daivatāya / atra^(āha gor(amanvata^iti cāndramasīṃ pañcamīṃ dyāvā.pṛthivībhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīmaho.rātrābhyāṃ saptamīṃ raudrīm aṣṭamīṃ saurīṃ navamīṃ vāruṇīṃdaśamīm aindrīm ekādaśīṃ vaiśvadevīṃ dvādaśīm iti //
body.translated_text: [He offers] to <s>Agni</s> [with the formula for] whatever <s>tithi</s> (lunar day) it may be, and to the <s>nakṣatra</s> (asterism) together with its deity. Here he recites [the formula] '<s>Gor amanvata</s>' ('They perceived the cow'): the fifth [day, dedicated] to the moon; the sixth to Heaven and Earth; the seventh to Day and Night; the eighth, the <s>Raudrī</s> (of <s>Rudra</s>); the ninth, the <s>Saurī</s> (of <s>Sūrya</s>); the tenth, the <s>Vāruṇī</s> (of <s>Varuṇa</s>); the eleventh, the <s>Aindrī</s> (of <s>Indra</s>); the twelfth, the <s>Vaiśvadevī</s> (of the All-gods) — thus.

body.text: Baudh3.8.9/ atha^aparāḥ (samāmananti digbhyaś ca sa.daivatābhya urorantarikṣāya sa.daivatāya //
body.translated_text: And others enumerate [additionally]: to the quarters together with their deities, to the broad [space], and to the atmosphere together with its deity.

body.text: Baudh3.8.10/ navo.navo (bhavati jāyamāna iti sauviṣṭakṛtīṃ(hutvā^atha^etad^havir.ucchiṣṭaṃ kaṃse vā camase vā (vyuddhṛtyahaviṣyair vyañjanair (upasicya pañcadaśa piṇḍān prakṛti.sthān (prāśnāti//
body.translated_text: '<s>Navo-navo bhavati jāyamānaḥ</s>' ('Ever new he becomes when born') — having offered the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s> (offering to the fire-god for making the offering complete), then having ladled out the remnant of that oblation-food into a metal cup or a wooden bowl, and having mixed it with oblation-worthy condiments, he eats fifteen morsels of standard size.

body.text: Baudh3.8.11/ prāṇāya tvā^iti prathamam / apānāya tvā^iti dvitīyam /vyānāya tvā^iti tṛtīyam / udānāya tvā^iti caturtham / samānāyatvā^iti pañcamam / yadā catvāro dvābhyāṃ pūrvam / yadā trayodvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ pūrvau / yadā dvau dvābhyāṃ pūrvaṃ tribhiruttaram / ekaṃ sarvaiḥ //
body.translated_text: '<s>Prāṇāya tvā</s>' ('For <s>prāṇa</s>, [I consume] you') — the first; '<s>Apānāya tvā</s>' ('For <s>apāna</s>') — the second; '<s>Vyānāya tvā</s>' ('For <s>vyāna</s>') — the third; '<s>Udānāya tvā</s>' ('For <s>udāna</s>') — the fourth; '<s>Samānāya tvā</s>' ('For <s>samāna</s>') — the fifth. When [there are] four [morsels], two [are eaten] before [the five breath-dedications]; when three, two [sets of] two before; when two, two before and three after; one [morsel is eaten] with all [five dedications].

body.text:
Baudh3.8.12/ nigrābhyā stha^iti / apaḥ (pītvā^atha^ājya.āhutīr(upajuhoti / prāṇa.apāna.vyāna.udāna.samānā me (śudhyantāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā (bhūyāsaṃ svāhā / vāṅ.manaḥ / śiraḥ.pāṇi /tvak.carma.māṃsa [K: tvakcarma] / śabda.sparśa.rūpa [K: śabdasparśa] /pṛthivy.ap.tejo [K: pṛthivī] /annamaya.prāṇamaya.manomaya.vijñānamaya.ānandamayā me (śudhyantāṃjyotir
ahaṃ virajā vipāpmā (bhūyāsaṃ svāhā^iti [K:annamayaprāṇamaya ity etais] saptabhir anuvākaiḥ //
body.translated_text: '<s>Nigrābhyā stha</s>' ('You are restrainers') — having drunk water, he then offers <s>ājya</s> (ghee) oblations: 'May my <s>prāṇa</s>, <s>apāna</s>, <s>vyāna</s>, <s>udāna</s>, and <s>samāna</s> be purified; may I become radiant, free from impurity, free from sin, <s>svāhā</s>'; [then] 'speech and mind'; 'head and hands'; 'skin, hide, and flesh'; 'sound, touch, and form'; 'earth, water, and fire'; 'may my [sheaths] made of food, made of breath, made of mind, made of knowledge, and made of bliss be purified; may I become radiant, free from impurity, free from sin, <s>svāhā</s>' — with these seven <s>anuvākas</s> (sections).

body.text: Baudh3.8.13/ jaya.prabhṛti siddham ā dhenu.vara.pradānāt //
body.translated_text: From the <s>jaya</s> [oblations] onward, the procedure is established, up to the giving of the cow as a gift.

body.text: Baudh3.8.14/ saurībhir ādityam (upatiṣṭhate cāndramasībhiś candramasam //
body.translated_text: He worships the sun with [verses] addressed to <s>Sūrya</s>, and the moon with [verses] addressed to the moon.

body.text: Baudh3.8.15/ agne tvaṃ su (jāgṛhi^iti saṃviśañ (japati //
body.translated_text: '<s>Agne tvaṃ su jāgṛhi</s>' ('O <s>Agni</s>, keep well awake') — he recites this when going to sleep.

body.text: Baudh3.8.16/ tvam agne vrata.pā (asi^iti prabuddhaḥ //
body.translated_text: '<s>Tvam Agne vratapā asi</s>' ('You, O <s>Agni</s>, are the guardian of vows') — [he recites this] upon awakening.

body.text: Baudh3.8.17/ strī.śūdrair na^(abhibhāṣeta mūtra.purīṣe na^(avekṣeta //
body.translated_text: He should not converse with women or <s>śūdras</s>, and should not look at urine or excrement.

body.text:
Baudh3.8.18/ amedhyaṃ (dṛṣṭvā (japati / abaddhaṃ mano daridraṃ cakṣuḥ sūryojyotiṣāṃ śreṣṭho dīkṣe mā mā (hāsīr iti // [K adds: atha yady enamabhivarṣaty undatīr balaṃ dhatteti]
Baudh3.8.19/ prathamāyām apara.pakṣasya caturdaśa grāsān //
body.translated_text: Upon seeing something impure, he recites: '<s>Abaddhaṃ mano daridraṃ cakṣuḥ, sūryo jyotiṣāṃ śreṣṭho, dīkṣe mā mā hāsīḥ</s>' ('The mind is unbound, the eye is wanting; the sun is the best of lights — O consecration, do not abandon me'). On the first [day] of the dark fortnight, [he eats] fourteen morsels.

body.text: Baudh3.8.20/ evam eka.apacayena^ā^amāvāsyāyāḥ //
body.translated_text: Thus, decreasing by one [morsel each day], until the new-moon day.

body.text: Baudh3.8.21/ amāvāsyāyāṃ grāso na (vidyate //
body.translated_text: On the new-moon day, no morsel is [to be eaten].

body.text: Baudh3.8.22/ atha [K omits atha] prathamāyāṃ pūrva.pakṣasya^ekaḥ / dvaudvitīyāyām [K: dvitīyasyām] //
body.translated_text: Then, on the first [day] of the bright fortnight, one [morsel]; two on the second.

body.text: Baudh3.8.23/ evam eka.upacayena^ā paurṇamāsyāḥ //
body.translated_text: Thus, increasing by one [each day], until the full-moon day.

body.text: Baudh3.8.24/ paurṇamāsyāṃ sthālīpākasya (juhoty agnaye yā tithiḥ (syānnakṣatrebhyaś ca sa.daivatebhyaḥ //
body.translated_text: On the full-moon day, he offers a <s>sthālīpāka</s> (pot-cooked offering) [with the formula] 'To <s>Agni</s>, whatever <s>tithi</s> (lunar day) it may be, and to the <s>nakṣatras</s> (asterisms) together with their deities.'

body.text: Baudh3.8.25/ purastāt^śroṇāyā abhijitaḥ sa.daivatasya (hutvā gāṃbrāhmaṇebhyo (dadyāt //
body.translated_text: Having offered before [the asterism] <s>Śroṇā</s>, to <s>Abhijit</s> together with its deity, he should give a cow to brahmins.

body.text: Baudh3.8.26/ tad etac cāndrāyaṇaṃ pipīlikā.madhyam / viparītaṃ yava.madhyam //
body.translated_text: This is the <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s> called <s>pipīlikā-madhya</s> (ant-shaped, i.e., tapering in the middle). The reverse is <s>yava-madhya</s> (barley-shaped, i.e., swelling in the middle).

body.text: Baudh3.8.27/ ato^anyatarac (caritvā sarvebhyaḥ pātakebhyaḥ pāpakṛt^śuddho(bhavati //
body.translated_text: Having performed either of these, a sinner is purified from all sins.

body.text: Baudh3.8.28/ kāmāya kāmāya^etad āhāryam ity (ācakṣate //
body.translated_text: They declare that this may be undertaken for any desired purpose.

body.text: Baudh3.8.29/ yaṃ kāmaṃ (kāmayate tam etena^(āpnoti //
body.translated_text: Whatever desire one desires, one attains it through this.

body.text: Baudh3.8.30/ etena vā ṛṣaya ātmānaṃ (śodhayitvā purā karmāṇy (asādhayan/ tad etad dhanyaṃ puṇyaṃ putryaṃ pautryaṃ paśavyam āyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃyaśasyaṃ sārvakāmikam //
body.translated_text: By this [rite], the <s>ṛṣis</s> (sages), having purified themselves, formerly accomplished [great] deeds. This is auspicious, meritorious, bestowing sons, grandsons, cattle, long life, heaven, fame, and the fulfillment of all desires.

body.text: Baudh3.8.31/ nakṣatrāṇāṃ dyutiṃ sūryā.candramasor eva [K omits eva]sāyujyaṃ salokatām (āpnoti ya u ca^enad (adhīte / ya u ca^enad (adhīte//
body.translated_text: One attains the splendor of the <s>nakṣatras</s> (stars), union and co-residence with the sun and the moon — and [so does] one who studies this; and one who studies this.

body.text: Baudh3.9.1/ atha^ato^anaśnat.pārāyaṇa.vidhiṃ (vyākhyāsyāmaḥ //
body.translated_text: Now we shall explain the procedure of the <s>anaśnat-pārāyaṇa</s> (recitation while fasting).

body.text: Baudh3.9.2/ śuci.vāsāḥ (syāc cīra.vāsā vā //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.2: He should wear clean garments, or garments made of bark.

body.text: Baudh3.9.3/ haviṣyam annam (icched apaḥ phalāni vā //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.3: He should desire <s>haviṣya</s> (sacrificially pure) food, or water and fruits.

body.text:
Baudh3.9.4/ grāmāt prācīṃ vā^udīcīṃ vā diśam (upaniṣkramya gomayenago.carma.mātraṃ catur.aśraṃ sthaṇḍilam (upalipya (prokṣya lakṣaṇam(ullikhya adbhir (abhyukṣya agnim (upasamādhāya (saṃparistīrya^etābhyodevatābhyo (juhuyāt / agnaye svāhā / prajāpataye svāhā / somāyasvāhā [K: somāya svāhā prajāpataye svāhā] viśvebhyo devebhyaḥsvayaṃbhuva ṛgbhyo yajurbhyaḥ
sāmabhyo^atharvabhyaḥ śraddhāyai prajñāyaimedhāyai śriyai hriyai savitre sāvitryai sadasaspataye^anumataye ca [Kadds: vyāharen na cāntarā viramet] //
body.translated_text:
Baudh3.9.4: Going forth from the village in an easterly or northerly direction, having smeared a square altar the size of a cow-hide with cow-dung, having sprinkled it, having drawn the lines, having sprinkled it with water, having set up the fire, having strewn [the sacred grass] around it, he should offer oblations to these deities: 'To <s>Agni</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Prajāpati</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Soma</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' [K: 'To <s>Soma</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Prajāpati</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!'] 'To the <s>Viśvedevas</s> (All-gods), to the self-born one, to the <s>Ṛc</s> verses, to the <s>Yajus</s> formulas,
to the <s>Sāman</s> chants, to the <s>Atharvan</s> hymns, to <s>Śraddhā</s> (Faith), to <s>Prajñā</s> (Wisdom), to <s>Medhā</s> (Intelligence), to <s>Śrī</s> (Prosperity), to <s>Hrī</s> (Modesty), to <s>Savitṛ</s>, to <s>Sāvitrī</s>, to <s>Sadaspati</s> (Lord of the Assembly), and to <s>Anumati</s> (Approval).' [K adds: 'He should recite and should not pause in between.']

body.text:
Baudh3.9.5/ (hutvā veda.ādim (ārabheta saṃtatam (adhīyīta // [K omits]
Baudh3.9.6/ na^antarā (vyāharen na ca^antarā (viramet // [K omits]
Baudh3.9.7/ atha^antarā (vyāhared atha^antarā (viramet triḥ [K: trīn]prāṇān (āyamya vṛttāntād eva^(ārabheta //
body.translated_text:
Baudh3.9.5: Having offered, he should begin the <s>Veda</s> from the beginning and recite continuously. [K omits]
Baudh3.9.6: He should not speak in between, nor should he pause in between. [K omits]
Baudh3.9.7: Now, if he speaks in between or pauses in between, having held three <s>prāṇas</s> (breath-retentions), he should resume from the section [where he stopped].

body.text: Baudh3.9.8/ apratibhāyāṃ yāvatā kālena na veda tāvantaṃ kālaṃ tad(adhīyīta sa yadā (jānīyād [K: yaj jānīyāt] ṛkto yajuṣṭaḥ sāmataiti //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.8: In case of failure of memory, for as long a time as he does not know [the passage], for that long he should recite it, until he knows whether it is from the <s>Ṛc</s> [K: when he knows it], or from the <s>Yajus</s>, or from the <s>Sāman</s>.

body.text: Baudh3.9.9/ tad.brāhmaṇaṃ tac.chāndasaṃ tad.daivatam (adhīyīta //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.9: He should recite its <s>brāhmaṇa</s> (explanatory text), its <s>chandas</s> (metrical portion), and its <s>daivata</s> (deity section).

body.text: Baudh3.9.10/ dvādaśa veda.saṃhitā (adhīyīta / yadanena^anadhyāye^(adhīyīta yad guravaḥ kopitā yāny akāryāṇi (bhavantitābhiḥ (punīte / śuddham asya pūtaṃ brahma (bhavati //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.10: He should recite twelve <s>Veda-saṃhitās</s> (collected texts of the Veda). Whatever [faults] he incurs by reciting on a day unfit for study, whatever [anger] of teachers is provoked, whatever improper actions there may be — from all these he is purified. His <s>Brahman</s> (sacred knowledge) becomes pure and cleansed.

body.text: Baudh3.9.11/ ata ūrdhvaṃ saṃcayaḥ //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.11: From this point onward is the accumulation [of merit].

body.text: Baudh3.9.12/ aparā dvādaśa veda.saṃhitā (adhītya tābhir uśanaso lokam(avāpnoti //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.12: Having recited another twelve <s>Veda-saṃhitās</s>, by these he attains the world of <s>Uśanas</s>.

body.text: Baudh3.9.13/ aparā dvādaśa veda.saṃhitā (adhītya tābhir bṛhaspater lokam(avāpnoti //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.13: Having recited another twelve <s>Veda-saṃhitās</s>, by these he attains the world of <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

body.text: Baudh3.9.14/ aparā dvādaśa veda.saṃhitā (adhītya tābhiḥ prajāpater lokam(avāpnoti //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.14: Having recited another twelve <s>Veda-saṃhitās</s>, by these he attains the world of <s>Prajāpati</s>.

body.text: Baudh3.9.15/ anaśnan saṃhitā sahasram (adhīyīta / brahma.bhūto virajo [K:virājo] brahma (bhavati //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.15: Fasting, he should recite a thousand <s>saṃhitās</s> (collected texts). Having become <s>Brahman</s>, he becomes stainless [K: illustrious] <s>Brahman</s>.

body.text: Baudh3.9.16/ saṃvatsaraṃ bhaikṣaṃ prayuñjāno divyaṃ cakṣur (labhate //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.16: One who subsists on alms for a year obtains the divine eye.

body.text: Baudh3.9.17/ ṣaṇ māsān yāvaka.bhakṣaś caturo māsān udaka.saktu.bhakṣo dvaumāsau phala.bhakṣo māsam ab.bhakṣo dvādaśa.rātraṃ vā^aprāśnan kṣipram(antardhīyate jñātīn punāti sapta^avarān sapta pūrvān ātmānaṃpañcadaśaṃ paṅktiṃ ca (punāti //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.17: For six months eating barley gruel, for four months consuming water-and-barley-flour, for two months eating fruits, for one month subsisting on water alone, or fasting for twelve nights — he quickly vanishes [from the cycle of rebirth]. He purifies his kinsmen, seven generations after him and seven before, himself being the fifteenth, and he purifies [his] lineage.

body.text: Baudh3.9.18/ tām etāṃ deva.niśrayaṇī^ity [K: devaniśśrayaṇīty] (ācakṣate //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.18: They call this the 'Ladder to the Gods' (<s>deva-niśrayaṇī</s>) [K: <s>devaniśśrayaṇī</s>].

body.text: Baudh3.9.19/ etayā vai devā devatvam (agacchann ṛṣaya ṛṣitvam //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.19: By this indeed the gods attained godhood and the sages attained sagehood.

body.text: Baudh3.9.20/ tasya ha vā etasya yajñasya trividha eva^ārambha.kālaḥprātaḥ.savane mādhyaṃdine savane brāhme vā^apara.rātre //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.20: Of this sacrifice, there is indeed a threefold time for commencement: at the morning pressing, at the midday pressing, or at the <s>brāhma</s> (sacred) hour in the last watch of the night.

body.text: Baudh3.9.21/ taṃ vā etaṃ prajāpatiḥ saptarṣibhyaḥ (provāca saptarṣayomahājajñave mahājajñur brāhmaṇebhyaḥ / brāhmaṇebhyaḥ //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.9.21: This, <s>Prajāpati</s> taught to the seven sages; the seven sages [taught it] to <s>Mahājajñu</s>; <s>Mahājajñu</s> [taught it] to the <s>brāhmaṇas</s>. [Thus it was transmitted] to the <s>brāhmaṇas</s>.

body.text: Baudh3.10.1/ ukto varṇa.dharmaś ca^āśrama.dharmaś ca //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.1: The <s>varṇa-dharma</s> (duties of the social classes) and the <s>āśrama-dharma</s> (duties of the life-stages) have been described.

body.text: Baudh3.10.2/ atha khalv ayaṃ puruṣo yāpyena karmaṇā mithyā vā (caratyayājyaṃ vā (yājayaty apratigrāhyasya vā (pratigṛhṇāty anāśya.annasyavā^annam (aśnāty acaraṇīyena vā (carati //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.2: Now, indeed, this person, through blameworthy action, either conducts himself wrongly, or officiates at a sacrifice for one who should not be sacrificed for, or accepts [gifts] from one whose gifts should not be accepted, or eats the food of one whose food should not be eaten, or conducts himself in a manner that should not be followed.

body.text: Baudh3.10.3/ tatra prāyaścittaṃ (kuryān na (kuryād iti (mīmāṃsante [Komits mīmāṃsante] //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.3: Regarding that, they debate [K omits 'they debate'] whether one should perform <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) or not.

body.text: Baudh3.10.4/ nahi karma (kṣīyata iti //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.4: For ritual action is never destroyed [without bearing fruit].

body.text: Baudh3.10.5/ (kuryād ity [K: kuryāt tv] eva //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.5: One should indeed perform [expiation] [K: but one should perform it].

body.text: Baudh3.10.6/ punastomena^iṣṭvā [K: punastomena yajeta] punaḥ savanamāyānti^iti [K: āyantīti] (vijñāyate //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.6: It is known [from scripture] that 'Having sacrificed with the <s>Punaḥstoma</s> (re-pressing rite) [K: one should sacrifice with the <s>Punaḥstoma</s>], they return again to the <s>savana</s> (pressing)' [K: 'they return'].

body.text: Baudh3.10.7/ atha^apy (udāharanti / sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ (tarati (taratibrahmahatyāṃ yo^aśvamedhena (yajata iti //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.7: And they also cite [this verse]: 'One crosses over all sin, one crosses over even <s>brahmahatyā</s> (the slaying of a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>), who sacrifices with the <s>Aśvamedha</s> (horse sacrifice).'

body.text: Baudh3.10.8/ agniṣṭutā vā^abhiśaṃsyamāno [K: vābhiśasyamāno] (yajeta^iti ca //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.8: 'Or one who is accused [K: who is being accused] should sacrifice with the <s>Agniṣṭut</s> (fire-praise rite).'

body.text: Baudh3.10.9/ tasya niṣkrayaṇāni japas tapo homa upavāso dānam //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.9: The means of redemption for that [sin] are: <s>japa</s> (recitation), <s>tapas</s> (austerity), <s>homa</s> (oblation), <s>upavāsa</s> (fasting), and <s>dāna</s> (gift-giving).

body.text: Baudh3.10.10/ upaniṣado vedādayo vedāntāḥ sarvacchandaḥsu saṃhitā madhūnyaghamarṣaṇam atharvaśiro rudrāḥ puruṣasūktaṃ rājana.rauhiṇe sāmanībṛhad.rathaṃtare puruṣagatir mahānāmnyo mahāvairājaṃ mahādivākīrtyaṃjyeṣṭha.sāmnām anyatamaṃ bahiṣpavamānaḥ [K: bahiṣpavamānaṃ]kūśmāṇḍyaḥ pāvamānyaḥ sāvitrī ca^iti pāvanāni //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.10: The purificatory [texts] are: the <s>Upaniṣads</s>, the beginnings of the <s>Vedas</s>, the ends of the <s>Vedas</s>, the <s>saṃhitā</s> (collected text) of all meters, the <s>Madhus</s> (honey hymns), the <s>Aghamarṣaṇa</s> (sin-effacing hymn), the <s>Atharvaśiras</s>, the <s>Rudras</s>, the <s>Puruṣasūkta</s>, the <s>Rājana</s> and <s>Rauhiṇa</s> <s>Sāmans</s>, the <s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s> [<s>Sāmans</s>], the <s>Puruṣagati</s>, the <s>Mahānāmnīs</s>, the <s>Mahāvairāja</s>, the <s>Mahādivākīrtya</s>, any one of the <s>Jyeṣṭhasāmans</s>, the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> [K: <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s>], the <s>Kūṣmāṇḍī</s> hymns, the <s>Pāvamānī</s> verses, and the <s>Sāvitrī</s>.

body.text: Baudh3.10.11/ upasan.nyāyena payovratatā śākabhakṣatā phalabhakṣatāmūlabhakṣatā prasṛti.yāvako hiraṇya.prāśanaṃ ghṛta.prāśanaṃsoma.pānam iti medhyāni //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.11: By way of subsidiary observance: the milk-vow, subsisting on vegetables, subsisting on fruits, subsisting on roots, a handful of barley-gruel, consuming gold, consuming ghee, and drinking <s>Soma</s> — these are the purifying [substances].

body.text: Baudh3.10.12/ sarve śiloccayāḥ sarvāḥ sravantyaḥ saritaḥ puṇyā hradāstīrthāny ṛṣi.niketanāni goṣṭha.kṣetra.pariṣkandā iti deśāḥ //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.12: All mountain peaks, all flowing streams, holy rivers, sacred pools, <s>tīrthas</s> (pilgrimage sites), hermitages of sages, and the boundaries of cow-pens and [sacrificial] fields — these are the [purifying] places.

body.text: Baudh3.10.13/ ahiṃsā satyam astainyaṃ savaneṣu^udaka.upasparśanaṃguru.śuśrūṣā brahmacaryam adhaḥ.śayanam ekavastratā^anāśaka ititapāṃsi //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.13: Non-violence, truthfulness, non-stealing, touching water at the <s>savana</s> (pressing) times, service to the teacher, <s>brahmacarya</s> (celibacy), sleeping on the ground, wearing a single garment, and fasting — these are the austerities.

body.text: Baudh3.10.14/ hiraṇyaṃ gaur vāso^aśvo bhūmis tilā ghṛtam annam iti deyāni //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.14: Gold, a cow, a garment, a horse, land, sesame seeds, ghee, and food — these are the things to be given.

body.text: Baudh3.10.15/ saṃvatsaraḥ ṣaṇ.māsāś catvāras trayo dvāv ekaścaturviṃśaty.aho dvādaśa.ahaḥ ṣaḍ.ahas try.aho^aho.rātra eka.aha itikālāḥ //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.15: A year, six months, four [months], three, two, one, twenty-four days, twelve days, six days, three days, a day-and-night, and a single day — these are the [prescribed] time-periods.

body.text: Baudh3.10.16/ etāny anādeśe (kriyeran //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.16: These should be employed when no specific instruction is given.

body.text: Baudh3.10.17/ enaḥsu guruṣu gurūṇi laghuṣu laghūni //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.17: For grave sins, the [penances should be] heavy; for minor ones, light.

body.text: Baudh3.10.18/ kṛcchra.atikṛcchrau cāndrāyaṇam iti sarva.prāyaścittiḥ /sarva.prāyaścittiḥ //
body.translated_text: Baudh3.10.18: The <s>kṛcchra</s> (severe penance), the <s>atikṛcchra</s> (exceedingly severe penance), and the <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s> (lunar penance) — these constitute the universal expiation.

body.text:

body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.1: We shall declare the <s>prāyaścittas</s> (expiations), of various purposes, each separately,
and for each of those offenses, [expiations] both heavy and light.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.2ab/ yady atra hi (bhaved yuktaṃ tad^hi tatra^eva (nirdiśet /
Baudh4.1.2cd/ bhūyo.bhūyo garīyaḥsu laghuṣv alpīyasas tathā //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.2: If what is appropriate here were prescribed there as well,
then for progressively graver [offenses, the penances should be] heavier, and for minor ones, correspondingly lighter.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.3ab/ vidhinā śāstra.dṛṣṭena prāṇa.āyāmān (samācaret /

body.translated_text: Baudh4.1.4: Or [alternatively] [K: 'then by speech'], for transgressions of the eyes, ears, skin, nose, and mind, one is purified by three <s>prāṇāyāmas</s> (breath-restraints).

body.text: Baudh4.1.5/ śūdra.anna.strī.gamana.bhojaneṣu kevaleṣu pṛthak.pṛthaksapta.ahaṃ sapta.sapta prāṇa.āyāmān (dhārayet //
body.translated_text: Baudh4.1.5: For eating the food of a <s>śūdra</s>, consorting with women [of low caste], and [partaking of improper] meals — for each of these separately — one should perform seven <s>prāṇāyāmas</s> (breath-restraints) each day for seven days.

body.text: Baudh4.1.6/ abhakṣya.abhojya.apeya.anādya.prāśaneṣu tathā^apaṇya.vikrayeṣumadhu.māṃsa.ghṛta.taila.kṣāra.lavaṇa.avara.anna.varjeṣu yac ca^anyad apyevaṃ.yuktaṃ dvādaśa.ahaṃ dvādaśa.dvādaśa prāṇa.āyāmān (dhārayet //
body.translated_text: Baudh4.1.6: For consuming what should not be eaten, what should not be partaken, what should not be drunk, or what should not be tasted, and likewise for selling forbidden merchandise — excluding honey, meat, ghee, oil, alkali, salt, and inferior grains — and whatever else is of this kind, one should perform twelve <s>prāṇāyāmas</s> (breath-restraints) each day for twelve days.

body.text: Baudh4.1.7/ pātaka.patanīya.upapātaka.varjeṣu yac ca^anyad apy evaṃ.yuktamardhamāsaṃ dvādaśa.dvādaśa prāṇa.āyāmān (dhārayet //
body.translated_text: Baudh4.1.7: Excluding <s>pātaka</s> (mortal sins), <s>patanīya</s> (sins causing loss of caste), and <s>upapātaka</s> (minor sins) — and whatever else is of this kind — one should perform twelve <s>prāṇāyāmas</s> (breath-restraints) each day for half a month.

body.text: Baudh4.1.8/ pātaka.patanīya.varjeṣu yac ca^anyad apy evaṃ.yuktaṃ dvādaśadvādaśa.ahān dvādaśa.dvādaśa prāṇa.āyāmān (dhārayet //
body.translated_text: Baudh4.1.8: Excluding <s>pātaka</s> (mortal sins) and <s>patanīya</s> (sins causing loss of caste) — and whatever else is of this kind — one should perform twelve <s>prāṇāyāmas</s> (breath-restraints) each day for twelve periods of twelve days.

body.text: Baudh4.1.9/ pātaka.varjeṣu yac ca^anyad apy evaṃ.yuktaṃ dvādaśa.ardhamāsāndvādaśa.dvādaśa prāṇa.āyāmān (dhārayet //
body.translated_text: Baudh4.1.9: Excluding <s>pātaka</s> (mortal sins) — and whatever else is of this kind — one should perform twelve <s>prāṇāyāmas</s> (breath-restraints) each day for twelve half-months.

body.text: Baudh4.1.10/ atha pātakeṣu saṃvatsaraṃ dvādaśa.dvādaśa prāṇa.āyāmān(dhārayet //
body.translated_text: Baudh4.1.10: Now, for <s>pātakas</s> (mortal sins), one should perform twelve <s>prāṇāyāmas</s> (breath-restraints) each day for a year.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.11ab/ (dadyād guṇavate kanyāṃ nagnikāṃ brahmacāriṇe /
Baudh4.1.11cd/ api vā guṇa.hīnāya na^(uparundhyād rajasvalām //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.11: One should give a maiden, unclothed [i.e. before puberty], to a virtuous <s>brahmacārin</s> (celibate student);
or even to one deficient in virtues — one should not keep back [a daughter who has become] menstruating.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.12ab/ trīṇi varṣāṇy ṛtumatīṃ yaḥ kanyāṃ na (prayacchati /
Baudh4.1.12cd/ sa tulyaṃ bhrūṇa.hatyāyai doṣam (ṛcchaty asaṃśayam //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.12: He who does not give away a maiden for three years after she has reached puberty,
incurs sin equal to <s>bhrūṇahatyā</s> (embryo-killing), without doubt.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.13ab/ na (yācate ced evaṃ (syād yācate cet pṛthak.pṛthak /
Baudh4.1.13cd/ ekaikasminn ṛtau doṣaṃ pātakaṃ manur (abravīt //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.13: If no one asks [for her in marriage], it should be thus; but if suitors ask, [the sin falls] separately for each:
for each menstrual period, the sin is a <s>pātaka</s> (mortal sin) — so declared <s>Manu</s>.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.14ab/ trīṇi varṣāṇy ṛtumatī (kāṅkṣeta pitṛ.śāsanam /
Baudh4.1.14cd/ tataś caturthe varṣe tu (vindeta sadṛśaṃ patim /
Baudh4.1.14ef/ avidyamāne sadṛśe guṇa.hīnam api (śrayet //

Baudh4.1.15ab/ balāc cet prahṛtā kanyā mantrair yadi na saṃskṛtā /
Baudh4.1.15cd/ anyasmai vidhivad deyā yathā kanyā tathā^eva sā //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.15: If a maiden is taken away by force, and has not been consecrated with [wedding] <s>mantras</s>,
she may be lawfully given to another — she is as [pure as] a maiden still.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.16ab/ nisṛṣṭāyāṃ hute vā^api yasyai bhartā (mriyeta saḥ /
Baudh4.1.16cd/ sā ced akṣata.yoniḥ (syād gata.pratyāgatā satī /
Baudh4.1.16ef/ paunarbhavena vidhinā punaḥ.saṃskāram (arhati //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.16: If after the [maiden] has been given away or [the marriage] fire has been offered, her husband should die,
and if she remains with her womb intact, having gone and returned [i.e. been widowed],
she deserves re-consecration through the <s>paunarbhava</s> (re-marriage) rite.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.17ab/ trīṇi varṣāṇy ṛtumatīṃ yo bhāryāṃ na^(adhigacchati /
Baudh4.1.17cd/ sa tulyaṃ bhrūṇa.hatyāyai doṣam (ṛcchaty asaṃśayam //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.17: He who does not approach his wife for three years after she has reached puberty,
incurs sin equal to <s>bhrūṇahatyā</s> (embryo-killing), without doubt.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.18ab/ ṛtu.snātāṃ tu yo bhāryāṃ saṃnidhau na^upagacchati /
Baudh4.1.18cd/ pitaras tasya taṃ māsaṃ tasmin rajasi (śerate //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.18: He who does not approach his wife who has bathed after her menstrual period, while being near —
his ancestors lie in that [menstrual] blood for that month.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.19ab/ ṛtau na^(upaiti yo bhāryām anṛtau yaś ca (gacchati /
Baudh4.1.19cd/ tulyam (āhus tayor doṣam ayonau yaś ca (siñcati //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.19: He who does not approach his wife during her fertile period, and he who approaches her outside the fertile period —
they say the sin of both is equal, as [is the sin of] one who spills [his seed] in a non-womb.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.20ab/ bhartuḥ pratiniveśena yā bhāryā (skandayed ṛtum /
Baudh4.1.20cd/ tāṃ grāma.madhye (vikhyāpya bhrūṇa.ghnīṃ [ḥ: bhruṇa-](nirdhamed gṛhāt //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.20: A wife who, through aversion to her husband, causes her fertile period to pass —
her one should publicly denounce in the middle of the village as a slayer of the embryo and expel from the house.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.21ab/ ṛtu.snātāṃ na ced (gacchen niyatāṃ dharmacāriṇīm /
Baudh4.1.21cd/ niyama.atikrame tasya prāṇa.āyāma.śataṃ smṛtam //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.21: If he does not approach [his wife] who has bathed after her period, who is observant and righteous in conduct,
for that violation of the observance, a hundred <s>prāṇāyāmas</s> (breath-restraints) are prescribed.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.22ab/ prāṇa.āyāmān pavitrāṇi vyāhṛtīḥ praṇavaṃ tathā /
Baudh4.1.22cd/ pavitra.pāṇir āsīno brahma naityakam (abhyaset //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.22: <s>Prāṇāyāmas</s> (breath-restraints), purificatory [hymns], the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances), and the <s>Praṇava</s> (<s>Oṃ</s>) —
seated with purified hands, one should daily practice the eternal <s>Brahman</s>.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.23ab/ (āvartayet sadā yuktaḥ prāṇa.āyāmān punaḥ.punaḥ /
Baudh4.1.23cd/ ā keśa.antān nakha.agrāc ca tapas tapyata uttamam //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.23: Always disciplined, one should repeat <s>prāṇāyāmas</s> (breath-restraints) again and again;
from the tips of the hair to the tips of the nails, one performs the highest austerity.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.24ab/ nirodhāj (jāyate vāyur vāyor agniś ca (jāyate /
Baudh4.1.24cd/ tāpena^āpo^(adhijāyante tato^antaḥ (śudhyate tribhiḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.24: From restraint arises the wind [<s>vāyu</s>]; from the wind, fire is born;
from the heat, waters are produced — then one is inwardly purified by the three [elements].

body.text:
Baudh4.1.25ab/ yogena^(avāpyate jñānaṃ yogo dharmasya lakṣaṇam /
Baudh4.1.25cd/ yoga.mūlā guṇāḥ sarve tasmād yuktaḥ sadā (bhavet //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.25: Through <s>yoga</s> (discipline) knowledge is attained; <s>yoga</s> is the mark of <s>dharma</s> (law);
all virtues are rooted in <s>yoga</s> — therefore one should always be disciplined.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.26ab/ praṇava.ādyās trayo vedāḥ praṇave paryavasthitāḥ /
Baudh4.1.26cd/ praṇavo vyāhṛtayaś ca^eva nityaṃ brahma sanātanam //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.26: The three <s>Vedas</s>, beginning with <s>Praṇava</s> (<s>Oṃ</s>), are established in <s>Praṇava</s>;
<s>Praṇava</s> and the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances) are indeed the eternal, everlasting <s>Brahman</s>.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.27cd/ praṇave nitya.yuktasya vyāhṛtīṣu ca saptasu /
Baudh4.1.27cd/ tripadāyāṃ ca gāyatryāṃ na bhayaṃ (vidyate kvacit //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.27: For one who is ever devoted to <s>Praṇava</s> (<s>Oṃ</s>) and to the seven <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances),
and to the three-footed <s>Gāyatrī</s> — there is no fear anywhere.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.28ab/ savyāhṛtikāṃ sapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha /
Baudh4.1.28cd/ triḥ (paṭhed āyata.prāṇaḥ prāṇa.āyāmaḥ sa (ucyate //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.28: One should recite the <s>Gāyatrī</s> together with the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances), with <s>Praṇava</s> (<s>Oṃ</s>), and with the <s>Śiras</s> (head verse),
three times with extended breath — that is called <s>prāṇāyāma</s> (breath control).

body.text:
Baudh4.1.29ab/ savyāhṛtikāḥ sapraṇavāḥ prāṇa.āyāmās tu ṣoḍaśa /
Baudh4.1.29cd/ api bhrūṇa.hanaṃ māsāt (punanty ahar.ahar.dhṛtāḥ [K:aharahaḥ kṛtāḥ] //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.29: Sixteen <s>prāṇāyāmas</s> (breath controls) accompanied by the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances) and <s>Praṇava</s> (<s>Oṃ</s>),
practiced daily [K: performed daily], purify even the slayer of a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> within a month.

body.text:
Baudh4.1.30-1ab/ etad.ādyaṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭham etad dharmasya lakṣaṇam /
Baudh4.1.30-1cd/ sarva.doṣa.upaghāta.artham etad eva (viśiṣyate //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.1.30-1: This is the foremost austerity, this is the mark of <s>dharma</s> (law);
for the destruction of all faults, this alone is preeminent.

body.text: Baudh4.1.30-2/ etad eva (viśiṣyata iti //
body.translated_text: Baudh4.1.30-2: This alone is preeminent — thus [it is declared].

body.text:
Baudh4.2.1ab/ prāyaścittāni (vakṣyāmo nānā.arthāni pṛthak.pṛthak /
Baudh4.2.1cd/ teṣu.teṣu ca doṣeṣu garīyāṃsi laghūni ca //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.2.1: We shall now declare the <s>prāyaścittas</s> (expiations), of various purposes, one by one,
both the weighty and the light, for the respective offenses.

body.text:
Baudh4.2.2ab/ yady atra hi (bhaved yuktaṃ tad^hi tatra^eva (nirdiśet /
Baudh4.2.2cd/ bhūyo.bhūyo garīyaḥsu laghuṣv alpīyasas tathā //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.2.2: If indeed [an expiation] were suitable here, then one should prescribe that very one there;
for the graver [offenses], increasingly heavy [expiations], and likewise lighter ones for the lesser [offenses].

body.text: Baudh4.2.3ab/ vidhinā śāstra.dṛṣṭena prāyaścittāni (nirdiśet //
body.translated_text: Baudh4.2.3: One should prescribe the <s>prāyaścittas</s> (expiations) according to the rule seen in the <s>śāstra</s> (scripture).

body.text:
Baudh4.2.4ab/ pratigrahīṣyamāṇas tu (pratigṛhya tathā^eva ca /
Baudh4.2.4cd/ ṛcas taratsamandyas tu catasraḥ (parivartayet //
body.translated_text: Baudh4.2.4: One who is about to accept [a gift], as well as one who has [already] accepted, should recite the four <s>Ṛcs</s> (verses) of the <s>Taratsamandī</s> [hymn].

body.text:
Baudh4.2.5ab/ abhojyānāṃ tu sarveṣām abhojya.annasya bhojane /
Baudh4.2.5cd/ ṛgbhis taratsamandībhir [K: taratsamandīyair] mārjanaṃpāpa.śodhanam //
body.translated_text: Baudh4.2.5: For eating the food of all those whose food is not to be eaten, purification [is achieved] by the <s>Taratsamandī</s> [K: <s>Taratsamandīya</s>] <s>Ṛcs</s> (verses) — [this is] the cleansing of sin.

body.text:
Baudh4.2.6ab/ bhrūṇa.hatyā.vidhis tv anyas taṃ tu (vakṣyāmy ataḥ param /
Baudh4.2.6cd/ vidhinā yena (mucyante pātakebhyo^api sarvaśaḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.2.6: But the procedure for [expiation of] <s>bhrūṇahatyā</s> (embryo-slaying) is different; that I shall declare hereafter —
the method by which one is freed from all <s>pātakas</s> (mortal sins) entirely.

body.text:
Baudh4.2.7ab/ prāṇa.āyāmān pavitrāṇi vyāhṛtīḥ praṇavaṃ tathā /
Baudh4.2.7cd/ (japed aghamarṣaṇaṃ sūktaṃ [K: yuktaḥ] payasā dvādaśa kṣapāḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.2.7: One should perform <s>prāṇāyāmas</s> (breath controls), [recite] the <s>Pavitrās</s> (purificatory hymns), the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances), and <s>Praṇava</s> (<s>Oṃ</s>),
and recite the <s>Aghamarṣaṇa</s> <s>sūkta</s> (hymn) [K: while concentrated] for twelve nights, [subsisting on] milk.

body.translated_text: Baudh4.2.8: Or [one should observe] a three-night [fast], subsisting on air, wearing wet garments, bathing [K: wearing wet garments and bathing], [remaining] pure.

body.text:
Baudh4.2.9ab/ pratiṣiddhāṃs tathā^ācārān abhyasya^api punaḥ.punaḥ /
Baudh4.2.9cd/ vāruṇībhir (upasthāya sarva.pāpaiḥ (pramucyate // iti //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.2.9: Even having repeatedly practiced prohibited conduct,
by approaching [the deity] with the <s>Vāruṇī</s> (hymns addressed to <s>Varuṇa</s>), one is freed from all sins — thus [it is declared].

body.text:

Baudh2.1.1.34]
Baudh4.2.11/ hutvā prayata.añjaliḥ kavātiryaṅṅ agnim upatiṣṭheta / saṃ mā(siñcantu marutaḥ sam indraḥ saṃ bṛhaspatiḥ / saṃ mā^ayam agniḥ siñcatvāyuṣā ca balena ca^āyuṣmantaṃ (karota [K: karotu] mā^iti [= Baudh2.1.1.35]/ prati ha^asmai marutaḥ prāṇān (dadhati prati indro balaṃ pratibṛhaspatir brahmavarcasaṃ praty agnir itarat sarvam / sarva.tanur (bhūtvāsarvam
āyur (eti / trir (abhimantrayeta / triṣatyā hi devā iti(vijñāyate //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.2.10: Now, one who has broken his vow of chastity (<s>avakīrṇin</s>), on the new-moon night, having built up the fire and performed the ritual procedure of the <s>dārvihomikī</s> (wood-ladle oblation), offers two oblations of ghee: 'I, impelled by desire, have broken my vow; I have broken my vow, O <s>Kāma</s>! To <s>Kāma</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' 'I, assailed by desire, have been assailed; I have been assailed, O <s>Kāma</s>! To <s>Kāma</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' [cf. Baudh2.1.1.34]
Baudh4.2.11: Having offered [the oblations], with joined hands, turning sideways, he should praise the fire [with the verse]: 'May the <s>Maruts</s> sprinkle me, may <s>Indra</s>, may <s>Bṛhaspati</s>; may this <s>Agni</s> sprinkle me with long life and strength — may he make [K: let him make] me long-lived!' [= Baudh2.1.1.35] The <s>Maruts</s> indeed restore his vital breaths, <s>Indra</s> [restores] his strength, <s>Bṛhaspati</s> [restores] his <s>brahmavarcas</s> (Vedic splendor), and <s>Agni</s> [restores] everything else. Having become whole in body, he attains the full lifespan. He should recite [the mantra] three times. For it is known that 'the gods [act] in sets of three.'

body.translated_text: Baudh4.3.5: When one sprinkles the left hand, the feet, the head, the heart, the nostrils, the eyes, the ears, and touches the navel, by that one pleases the herbs, the forest trees, and all the deities. Therefore, by <s>ācamana</s> (sipping) alone, one is freed from all sin.

body.translated_text: Baudh4.3.6: Or one should place eight <s>samidhs</s> (fire-sticks) [into the fire, with the following mantras]: 'You are the expiation of sin committed by gods, <s>svāhā</s>!' 'You are the expiation of sin committed by humans, <s>svāhā</s>!' 'You are the expiation of sin committed by the ancestors, <s>svāhā</s>!' 'You are the expiation of whatever sin we have committed knowingly and unknowingly, <s>svāhā</s>!' 'You are the expiation of sin upon sin, <s>svāhā</s>!'

Baudh4.5.19cd/ niyata.ātmā haviṣyasya yati.cāndrāyaṇaṃ [ḥ: -cāndāyaṇaṃ](caret //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.5.19: Eight and eight morsels of <s>haviṣya</s> (sacrificial food) [each day] for one month, when the sun stands at midday,
with a controlled self — [this is] the <s>yati-cāndrāyaṇa</s> (ascetic's lunar penance) that one should practice.

body.text:
Baudh4.5.20ab/ yathā kathaṃcit piṇḍānāṃ dvijas tisras tv aśītayaḥ /
Baudh4.5.20cd/ māsena^aśnan haviṣyasya candrasya^(eti salokatām //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.5.20: A twice-born who, in whatever manner, eats three times eighty morsels
of <s>haviṣya</s> (sacrificial food) within a month attains the same world as the Moon.

body.text:
Baudh4.5.21ab/ yathā^udyaṃś candramā (hanti jagatas tamaso bhayam /
Baudh4.5.21cd/ evaṃ [K: tathā] pāpād bhayaṃ (hanti dvijaś cāndrāyaṇaṃ caran //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.5.21: Just as the rising Moon destroys the world's fear of darkness,
so [K: likewise] a twice-born practicing <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s> (lunar penance) destroys the fear born of sin.

body.text:
Baudh4.5.22ab/ kaṇa.piṇyāka.takrāṇi yava.ācāmo[K: tathā cāpo]^anila.aśanaḥ /
Baudh4.5.22cd/ eka.tri.pañca.sapta.iti pāpaghno^ayaṃ tulāpumān //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.5.22: Grains, oilcake, buttermilk, barley-water [K: and also water], and subsisting on air —
[taken in quantities of] one, three, five, and seven — this sin-destroying [penance] is called <s>tulāpuruṣa</s> (the balance-man penance).

body.text:
Baudh4.5.23ab/ yāvakaḥ sapta.rātreṇa vṛjinaṃ (hanti dehinām /
Baudh4.5.23cd/ sapta.rātra.upavāso vā dṛṣṭam etan manīṣibhiḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.5.23: A barley diet for seven nights destroys the sin of embodied beings;
or a seven-night fast — this has been seen by the wise.

body.text:
Baudh4.5.24ab/ pauṣa.bhādrapada.jyeṣṭhāsv [K: pauṣabhādrapadajyeṣṭhā]ārdra.ākāśa.ātapa.āśrayāt /
Baudh4.5.24cd/ trīn^śuklān (mucyate pāpāt patanīyād ṛte dvijaḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.5.24: In the months of <s>Pauṣa</s>, <s>Bhādrapada</s>, and <s>Jyeṣṭha</s> [K: <s>Pauṣabhādrapadajyeṣṭhā</s>], by resorting to moisture, open sky, and sun [respectively],
for three bright [fortnights], a twice-born is freed from sin, except for sins causing loss of caste.

body.text:
Baudh4.5.25ab/ go.mūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśa.udakam /
Baudh4.5.25cd/ yava.ācāmena saṃyukto brahmakūrco^atipāvanaḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.5.25: Cow's urine, cow dung, milk, curds, ghee, and water infused with <s>kuśa</s> grass,
combined with barley-water — [this] <s>brahmakūrca</s> (the Brahman's purgative) is exceedingly purifying.

body.text:
Baudh4.5.26ab/ amāvāsyāṃ nirāhāraḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ tila.aśanaḥ /
Baudh4.5.26cd/ śukla.kṛṣṇa.kṛtāt pāpān (mucyate abdasya parvabhiḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.5.26: Fasting on the new-moon day, eating sesame on the full-moon day —
one is freed from sin accumulated during the bright and dark [fortnights] through the <s>parvan</s> (juncture) days of the year.

body.text:
Baudh4.5.27ab/ bhaikṣa.āhāro^agnihotribhyo māsena^ekena (śudhyati /
Baudh4.5.27cd/ yāyāvara.vanasthebhyo daśabhiḥ pañcabhir dinaiḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.5.27: One who subsists on alms-food is purified in one month by [receiving food from] those who maintain the sacred fires;
from <s>yāyāvaras</s> (wandering householders) and <s>vānaprasthas</s> (forest-dwellers), in ten and five days [respectively].

body.text:
Baudh4.5.28ab/ ekāha.dhanino^annena dinena^ekena (śudhyati /
Baudh4.5.28cd/ kāpota.vṛtti.niṣṭhasya pītvā^apaḥ (śudhyate tribhiḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.5.28: One who possesses wealth for only a single day is purified in one day by [that] food;
one who follows the <s>kāpota-vṛtti</s> (pigeon-mode of living) is purified in three [days] by drinking water.

body.text:
Baudh4.5.29ab/ ṛg.yajuḥ.sāmavedānāṃ vedasya^anyatamasya vā /
Baudh4.5.29cd/ pārāyaṇaṃ trir (abhyasyed anaśnan so^atipāvanaḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.5.29: One who practices the complete recitation of the <s>Ṛg</s>, <s>Yajus</s>, and <s>Sāma Vedas</s>, or of any one <s>Veda</s>,
three times while fasting — that is exceedingly purifying.

body.text:
Baudh4.5.30ab/ atha cet (tvarate kartuṃ divasaṃ [K: divase] māruta.aśanaḥ /
Baudh4.5.30cd/ rātrau jala.sthito [K: jale sthito] vyuṣṭaḥ prājāpatyena tatsamam //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.5.30: Now, if one hastens to perform [this], subsisting on air for a day [K: on the day],
standing in water at night until dawn — that is equivalent to the <s>prājāpatya</s> (penance of <s>Prajāpati</s>).

body.text:
Baudh4.5.31ab/ gāyatryā^aṣṭa.sahasraṃ tu japaṃ (kṛtvā^utthite ravau /
Baudh4.5.31cd/ (mucyate sarva.pāpebhyo yadi na bhrūṇa.hā (bhavet //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.5.31: Having recited the <s>Gāyatrī</s> eight thousand times at sunrise,
one is freed from all sins, provided one has not killed an embryo.

body.text:
Baudh4.5.32ab/ yo^annadaḥ satyavādī ca bhūteṣu kṛpayā sthitaḥ /
Baudh4.5.32cd/ pūrva.ukta.yantra.śuddhebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ so^(atiricyate //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.5.32: He who is a giver of food, truthful, and abides in compassion toward beings,
surpasses all those purified by the previously mentioned disciplinary observances.

body.text:
Baudh4.6.1ab/ sa.mādhucchandasā rudrā gāyatrī praṇava.anvitā /
Baudh4.6.1cd/ sapta vyāhṛtayaś ca^eva japyāḥ [K: jāpyāḥ] pāpa.vināśanāḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.6.1: The <s>Rudrā</s> [hymns] together with the <s>Mādhucchandasa</s> [verses], the <s>Gāyatrī</s> accompanied by <s>Praṇava</s> (<s>Oṃ</s>),
and the seven <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances) — these are to be recited [K: chanted] for the destruction of sins.

body.text:
Baudh4.6.2ab/ mṛgāreṣṭiḥ pavitreṣṭis trihaviḥ pāvamāny api /
Baudh4.6.2cd/ iṣṭayaḥ pāpa.nāśinyo vaiśvānaryā samanvitāḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.6.2: The <s>Mṛgāreṣṭi</s>, <s>Pavitreṣṭi</s>, <s>Trihavis</s>, and the <s>Pāvamānī</s> [verses] also —
these sacrificial rites, together with the <s>Vaiśvānarī</s>, are destroyers of sin.

body.text:
Baudh4.6.3ab/ idaṃ ca^eva^aparaṃ guhyam ucyamānaṃ (nibodhata /
Baudh4.6.3cd/ (mucyate sarva.pāpebhyo mahataḥ pātakād ṛte //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.6.3: And now hear this further secret that is being declared:
one is freed from all sins, except for a great <s>pātaka</s> (mortal sin).

body.text:
Baudh4.6.4ab/ pavitrair mārjanaṃ kurvan rudra.ekādaśinīṃ [K:rudraikārdeśikāṃ] japan /
Baudh4.6.4cd/ pavitrāṇi ghṛtair juhvat prayacchan hema.go.tilān //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.6.4: Performing purification with the <s>Pavitra</s> [hymns], reciting the <s>Rudraikādaśinī</s> [K: <s>Rudraikārdeśikā</s>] (the eleven <s>Rudra</s> hymns),
offering the <s>Pavitra</s> [verses] with ghee, and giving gold, cows, and sesame —

body.text:
Baudh4.6.5ab/ yo^(aśnīyād yāvakaṃ pakvaṃ go.mūtre sa.śakṛd.rase /
Baudh4.6.5cd/ sa.dadhi.kṣīra.sarpiṣke (mucyate so^aṃhasaḥ kṣaṇāt //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.6.5: He who eats cooked barley in a broth of cow's urine mixed with cow dung,
curds, milk, and ghee — he is freed from sin instantly.

body.text:
Baudh4.6.6ab/ prasūto yaś ca śūdrāyāṃ yena^agamyā ca laṅghitā /
Baudh4.6.6cd/ sapta.rātrāt (pramucyete vidhinā^etena tāv ubhau //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.6.6: He who has begotten [a child] from a <s>Śūdra</s> woman, and he by whom a forbidden woman has been violated —
both of these two are freed within seven nights by this prescribed method.

body.text:
Baudh4.6.7ab/ reto.mūtra.purīṣāṇāṃ prāśane^abhojya.bhojane /
Baudh4.6.7cd/ paryādhāna.ijyayor etat parivitte ca bheṣajam //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.6.7: For the eating of semen, urine, and excrement, for eating with those with whom one should not eat,
for the re-establishment of the sacred fire and sacrifice, and for one who has been superseded [in marriage] — this is the remedy.

body.text:
Baudh4.6.8ab/ apātakāni karmāṇi kṛtvā^eva subahūny api /
Baudh4.6.8cd/ (mucyate sarva.pāpebhya ity etad vacanaṃ satām //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.6.8: Even having committed very many sinful acts that do not [constitute] mortal sins,
one is freed from all sins — this is the declaration of the virtuous.

body.text:
Baudh4.6.9ab/ mantra.mārga.pramāṇaṃ tu vidhānaṃ [K: vidhāne] samudīritam /
Baudh4.6.9cd/ bharadvāja.ādayo yena brahmaṇaḥ sātmatāṃ [K: samatāṃ] gatāḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.6.9: The procedure [K: in the procedure] proclaimed according to the authority of the <s>mantras</s> and their path,
by which <s>Bharadvāja</s> and others attained identity with [K: equality to] <s>Brahman</s>.

body.text:
Baudh4.6.10-1ab/ prasanna.hṛdayo vipraḥ prayogād asya karmaṇaḥ /
Baudh4.6.10-1cd/ kāmāṃs tāṃs tān (avāpnoti ye ye kāmā hṛdi sthitāḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.6.10-1: A <s>brāhmaṇa</s> with a serene heart, through the performance of this rite,
obtains those very desires that are established in [his] heart.

body.text: Baudh4.6.10-2/ ye ye kāmā hṛdi sthitā iti //
body.translated_text: Baudh4.6.10-2: [Those] very desires that are established in [his] heart — thus [ends the section].

body.text:
Baudh4.7.1ab/ nivṛttaḥ pāpa.karmabhyaḥ pravṛttaḥ puṇya.karmasu /
Baudh4.7.1cd/ yo vipras tasya (sidhyanti vinā yantrair api kriyāḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.7.1: The <s>brāhmaṇa</s> who has turned away from sinful deeds and is engaged in meritorious acts —
for him, ritual actions succeed even without [the preceding] disciplinary observances.

body.text:
Baudh4.7.2ab/ brāhmaṇā ṛjavas tasmād yad yad (icchanti cetasā /
Baudh4.7.2cd/ tat tad (āsādayanty āśu saṃśuddhā ṛju.karmabhiḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.7.2: <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> are straightforward; therefore, whatever they desire in their minds,
that they quickly attain, being purified through righteous deeds.

body.text:
Baudh4.7.3ab/ evam etāni yantrāṇi tāvat kāryāṇi dhīmatā /
Baudh4.7.3cd/ kālena yāvatā^(upaiti vigrahaḥ [K: vigrahaṃ] śuddhim ātmanaḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.7.3: Thus, these disciplinary observances should be performed by the wise
for as long a time as it takes for his body to attain purity of self.

body.text:
Baudh4.7.4ab/ ebhir yantrair viśuddha.ātmā tri.rātra.upoṣitas tataḥ /
Baudh4.7.4cd/ tad (ārabheta yena^ṛddhiṃ karmaṇā (prāptum (icchati //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.7.4: Having been purified in self through these disciplinary observances, then having fasted for three nights,
he should undertake that ritual action by which he wishes to attain prosperity.

body.text:
Baudh4.7.5ab/ kṣmāpavitraḥ [K: kṣāpavitraṃ] sahasrākṣo mṛgāro^aṃhomucau gaṇau /
Baudh4.7.5cd/ pāvamānyaś ca kūśmāṇḍyo vaiśvānarya ṛcaś ca yāḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.7.5: The <s>Kṣmāpavitra</s> [K: <s>Kṣāpavitra</s>], the <s>Sahasrākṣa</s>, the <s>Mṛgāra</s>, the <s>Aṃhomuc</s> hymn-groups,
the <s>Pāvamānīs</s>, the <s>Kūṣmāṇḍīs</s>, the <s>Vaiśvānarī</s> verses, and whichever other <s>ṛcs</s> —

body.text:
Baudh4.7.6ab/ ghṛta.odanena tā juhvat sapta.ahaṃ savana.trayam /
Baudh4.7.6cd/ mauna.vratī haviṣya.āśī nigṛhīta.indriya.kriyaḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.7.6: Offering these with ghee and rice at the three <s>savanas</s> (pressing-times) for seven days,
observing the vow of silence, eating <s>haviṣya</s> (sacrificial food), with senses and actions restrained —

body.text:
Baudh4.7.7ab/ siṃhe ma ity apāṃ pūrṇe pātre^(avekṣya catuṣ.pathe /
Baudh4.7.7cd/ (mucyate sarva.pāpebhyo mahataḥ pātakād api //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.7.7: [Reciting] 'siṃhe ma' while gazing into a vessel full of water at a crossroads,
one is freed from all sins, even from a great <s>pātaka</s> (mortal sin).

body.text:
Baudh4.7.8ab/ vṛddhatve yauvane bālye yaḥ kṛtaḥ pāpa.saṃcayaḥ /
Baudh4.7.8cd/ pūrva.janmasu ca^ajñānāt [K: vājñānāt] tasmād api (vimucyate //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.7.8: Whatever accumulation of sin was committed in old age, youth, or childhood,
and in previous births through ignorance [K: through ignorance] — from that too one is freed.

body.text:
Baudh4.7.9ab/ (bhojayitvā dvijān ante pāyasena sa.sarpiṣā [K: susarpiṣā] /
Baudh4.7.9cd/ go.bhūmi.tila.hemāni bhuktavadbhyaḥ (pradāya ca //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.7.9: Having fed <s>brāhmaṇas</s> at the end with <s>pāyasa</s> (milk-rice) mixed with ghee [K: with excellent ghee],
and having given cows, land, sesame, and gold to those who have eaten —

body.text:
Baudh4.7.10ab/ vipro (bhavati pūta.ātmā nirdagdha.vṛjina.indhanaḥ /
Baudh4.7.10cd/ kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ yogyas [K: yojyaḥ]tathā^ādhāna.ādi.karmaṇām //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.7.10: The <s>brāhmaṇa</s> becomes purified in self, with the fuel of sin burned away,
fit for <s>kāmya karmas</s> (rites of desire) and likewise for the rites beginning with the establishment of the sacred fire.

body.text:
Baudh4.8.1ab/ atilobhāt pramādād vā yaḥ (karoti kriyām imām /
Baudh4.8.1cd/ anyasya so^aṃhas.āviṣṭo gara.gīr iva (sīdati //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.8.1: He who performs this rite for another out of excessive greed or carelessness,
being possessed by sin, perishes like one who has swallowed poison.

body.text:
Baudh4.8.2ab/ ācāryasya pitur mātur ātmanaś ca kriyām imām /
Baudh4.8.2cd/ kurvan (bhāty arka.vad vipraḥ sā kāryā^eṣām ataḥ kriyā //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.8.2: But the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> who performs this rite for his teacher, father, mother, or himself
shines like the sun. Therefore, this rite should be performed for these [persons only].

body.text:
Baudh4.8.3ab/ ka etena sahasra.akṣaṃ pavitreṇa^(akarot^śucim /
Baudh4.8.3cd/ agniṃ vāyuṃ raviṃ somaṃ yama.ādīṃś ca sura.īśvarān //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.8.3: Who, through this <s>Pavitra</s> (purificatory rite), made the thousand-eyed [<s>Indra</s>] pure,
and [also] <s>Agni</s>, <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>Ravi</s> (the Sun), <s>Soma</s>, <s>Yama</s> and the other lords of the gods?

body.text:
Baudh4.8.4ab/ yat kiṃcit puṇya.nāma^iha triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam /
Baudh4.8.4cd/ vipra.ādi tat kṛtaṃ kena pavitra.kriyayā^anayā //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.8.4: Whatever bears a holy name here, renowned in the three worlds —
all that, beginning with the <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, was made [pure] by whom through this purificatory rite?

body.text:
Baudh4.8.5ab/ prājāpatyam [K: prajāpatyam] idaṃ guhyaṃ pāpa.ghnaṃprathama.udbhavam /
Baudh4.8.5cd/ samutpannāny ataḥ paścāt pavitrāṇi sahasraśaḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.8.5: This secret [rite] of <s>Prajāpati</s> [K: <s>Prajāpati</s>], the destroyer of sin, was the first to originate;
thereafter, thousands of purificatory [rites] arose from it.

body.text:
Baudh4.8.6ab/ yo^abda.āyana.ṛtu.pakṣa.ahān^(juhoty aṣṭau gaṇān imān /
Baudh4.8.6cd/ (punāti ca^ātmano vaṃśyān daśa pūrvān daśa^avarān [K:daśāparān] //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.8.6: He who offers these eight hymn-groups [throughout] years, half-years, seasons, fortnights, and days,
purifies ten [generations of] his ancestors and ten [generations of] his descendants [K: ten subsequent].

body.text:
Baudh4.8.7ab/ (jñāyate ca^amarair dyu.sthaiḥ puṇya.karmā^iti bhū.sthitaḥ /
Baudh4.8.7cd/ deva.vat^(modate bhūyaḥ svarga.loke^api puṇya.kṛt // [K putsthis verse after Baudh4.8.12]
Baudh4.8.8ab/ etān aṣṭau gaṇān (hotuṃ na (śaknoti yadi dvijaḥ /
Baudh4.8.8cd/ eko^api tena hotavyo rajas tena^asya (naśyati //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.8.7: And he, dwelling on earth, is recognized by the immortals dwelling in heaven as one of meritorious deeds;
the performer of merit rejoices yet more in the heavenly world, like the gods. [K places this verse after Baudh4.8.12]
Baudh4.8.8: If a twice-born is unable to offer these eight hymn-groups,
even one should be offered by him; by that his impurity is destroyed.

body.text:
Baudh4.8.9ab/ sūnavo yasya śiṣyā vā (juhvaty aṣṭau gaṇān imān /
Baudh4.8.9cd/ adhyāpana.parikrītair aṃhasaḥ so^api (mucyate //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.8.9: He whose sons or pupils offer these eight hymn-groups,
purchased through teaching — he too is freed from sin.

body.text:
Baudh4.8.10ab/ dhanena^api parikrītair ātma.pāpa.jighāṃsayā /
Baudh4.8.10cd/ hāvanīyā hy aśaktena na^avasādyaḥ śarīra.dhṛk //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.8.10: Even purchased through wealth, with the desire to destroy one's own sin,
the [offerings] should be made by one who is incapable; the embodied being should not be allowed to sink.

body.text:
Baudh4.8.11ab/ dhanasya (kriyate tyāgaḥ karmaṇāṃ sukṛtām api /
Baudh4.8.11cd/ puṃso^anṛṇasya pāpasya vimokṣaḥ (kriyate kvacit //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.8.11: Wealth is given up, and even well-performed ritual acts [are given up];
but the release of a man who is free of debts from sin is achieved only rarely.

body.text:
Baudh4.8.12ab/ vimukto [K: mukto yo] vidhinā^etena sarva.pāpārṇa.sāgarāt /
Baudh4.8.12cd/ ātmānaṃ (manyate śuddhaṃ samarthaṃ karma.sādhane //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.8.12: One freed [K: he who is freed] by this prescribed method from the ocean of all sins
regards himself as pure and capable of accomplishing ritual acts.

body.text:
Baudh4.8.13ab/ sarva.pāpārṇa.mukta.ātmā kriyā (ārabhate tu yāḥ /
Baudh4.8.13cd/ ayatnena^eva tāḥ siddhiṃ (yānti śuddha.śarīriṇaḥ //
body.translated_text:
Baudh4.8.13: He whose self is freed from the ocean of all sins, whatever ritual acts he undertakes,
those succeed effortlessly for one whose body is purified.

body.translated_text:
Baudh4.8.15: For twelve days, one should recite those <s>mantras</s> which one wishes to master,
having consumed rice with ghee, milk, and curds once at night. [K adds before Baudh4.8.16-1: 'Of the <s>Ṛg</s>, <s>Yajus</s>, <s>Sāma Vedas</s>, and also of the <s>Atharvāṅgirasas</s>.']
Baudh4.8.16-1: Likewise, the <s>homa</s> (oblation) [should be performed] ten times with ghee at the three <s>savanas</s> (pressing-times);
this is the preliminary observance for these [K: this] <s>mantras</s> in the accomplishment of ritual acts.

body.text: Baudh4.8.16-2/ mantrāṇāṃ karmasādhana iti //atilobhāt pramādād vā / nivṛttaḥ pāpakarmabhyaḥ // samādhuśchandasārudrāḥ // athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi // prāyaścittāni vakṣyāmaḥ //prāyaścittāni vakṣyāmaḥ // prāyaścittāni vakṣyāmaḥ // prāyaścittānivakṣyāmaḥ // iti caturthaḥ praśnaḥ //4
body.translated_text: Baudh4.8.16-2: [This is] for the accomplishment of ritual acts through <s>mantras</s> — thus [ends the section]. [Colophon markers:] 'Out of excessive greed or carelessness...' / 'Turned away from sinful deeds...' / 'Together with the <s>Mādhucchandasa</s> and <s>Rudrā</s> [hymns]...' / 'Now we shall declare...' / 'We shall declare the <s>prāyaścittas</s> (expiations)...' / 'We shall declare the <s>prāyaścittas</s> (expiations)...' / 'We shall declare the <s>prāyaścittas</s> (expiations)...' / 'We shall declare the <s>prāyaścittas</s> (expiations)...' / Thus ends the fourth <s>Praśna</s> (Book).
